name: Lost & Bound
source: Charles Henderson’s (First name can be changed) life is about to change. With a wife and four daughters to care for, he’s worked hard to ensure their happiness. Now his company’s newest app, Lost & Bound, is set to make a lot of money… or so he hopes. His ambitions threatened, his company at risk, his love life a tangled web… will Charles find a way out?​
translation: 查尔斯·亨德森（名字可以更改）的生活即将改变。他要照顾妻子和四个女儿，他努力工作以确保她们的幸福。现在，他公司的最新应用程序Lost & Bound将会赚很多钱……或者说他希望如此。他的野心受到威胁，他的公司面临风险，他的爱情生活错综复杂……查尔斯能找到出路吗？
